info.name: Timetable Admin API
info.description: Checkpoint C: health, authentication, stations, staff, simulator camera ingest, station-scoped alerts, analytics, audit listing, and SSE alert stream are implemented. Run npm run postman:admin or npm run postman:camera for isolated real HTTP workflows. SSE is a long-lived stream and cannot be executed via Newman; use Postman GUI or browser EventSource. Do not run the full Collection without an active session.

request.description: Requires ACKNOWLEDGED status and nonblank notes (1-1000 characters). Only the assigned handler or Super Admin may resolve.

request.description:
KONEKSI STREAM PANJANG — tidak dapat dieksekusi melalui Newman atau Collection Runner. Buka di browser menggunakan EventSource atau kirim melalui tab Postman biasa (koneksi tidak selesai sendiri).

Menggunakan cookie sesi admin_session yang sama dengan REST. Petugas menerima event stasiunnya saja; Super Admin menerima semua. Event: alert.created, alert.updated. Payload: alertId, stationId, status, occurredAt — tanpa PII.

Heartbeat tiap 15 detik, validasi sesi tiap 30 detik, batas 3 stream per akun / 500 per proses, stream ditutup setelah 5 menit. retry: 3000ms. Client harus memanggil GET /alerts saat reconnect karena SSE tidak menyediakan replay.

request.description: Ringkasan hari ini: total sesi, pengguna unik, sesi gagal, alert dibuat/selesai, sesi aktif, dan alert terbuka. Super Admin melihat semua stasiun; petugas otomatis difilter ke stasiunnya. Super Admin boleh mengirim ?stationId=uuid; petugas dilarang.

Statistik harian agregat. Parameter from/to format YYYY-MM-DD inklusif, maksimal 31 hari. Default 7 hari terakhir. Super Admin boleh menambahkan &stationId=uuid; petugas dilarang. Maks 5000 baris; truncated=true bila lebih.

Hanya Super Admin. Pagination default 25, maks 100. Filter opsional: stationId, action (ALERT_CREATED, ALERT_ACKNOWLEDGED, ALERT_RESOLVED, LOGIN, LOGOUT, dll.), from dan to (YYYY-MM-DD inklusif). Field details tidak dikembalikan.
Contoh filter audit berdasarkan action. Ganti action sesuai kebutuhan: LOGIN, LOGOUT, ALERT_ACKNOWLEDGED, ALERT_RESOLVED, STAFF_CREATED, STATION_CREATED, dll.
